svg.title: Introduction: All in One Stack — 根据演示截图复刻

g.text: One framework for all tasks (Code, Browser, GUI, ...)
Possibility to integrate multi-modality information and multi-agent collaboration
➢ Unified Gateway (Application), plug in any agent harness for RL training
Example: Claude Code, Mini-SWE-Agent, Hermes Agent
Bridge the harness gap between training and inference
